decision.observation: 1 mph, gear 1, all dots dark, no red X. The car has drifted off the left edge of the lane onto the grass verge; the tarmac curves right ahead past the striped barrel cluster, the OIL banner, and the red-roofed and yellow buildings, with the water's edge beyond.
decision.hypothesis: The W+D hold let the car slip off the left shoulder rather than track the right bend. Plain W should break the 1 mph crawl before any steering correction.
decision.memory: On this barrel cluster bend the car ends up left of the lane; the road arcs right, so the steering correction after a plain-W break should be D, kept short.
